title: Karma
description: The concept of action and consequence.
body:
# Karma

Karma refers to the idea that actions have consequences which determine future experiences.

## Types

There are diverse interpretations of karma across traditions.

## In daily life

Ethical actions are said to produce positive results while harmful actions produce negative results.

See also: [Dharma](/wiki/dharma).
